rosterSource: Major mapping platforms (agent-eval oriented) plus CARTO. No Agent = open OSM + MapLibre baseline.

runEnvironment.note: Each fighter pack was authored as a Cursor Agent run. Token counts are estimated from prompt/skills context + solution size (~4 chars/token), not billed API receipts  -  label them as estimates in the UI.

howToAdd: See ADDING_A_FIGHTER.md. Registry is the source of truth.

fighters.label: Google
fighters.apis: Maps, Geocoding, Places, Routes, Street View
fighters.agentTestFit: Gold standard for data accuracy; expensive at scale; good for testing agent robustness on rich POI and navigation tasks.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with the Google Maps JavaScript API. Load window.GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing keys. Prefer Maps JS + Places/Geocoder/DirectionsService where the skill needs search or routing.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with Google agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/googlemaps/agent-skills

fighters.label: Mapbox
fighters.agentTestFit: Highly customizable vector tiles and styles; strong docs and SDKs; mid-range pricing; ideal for testing dynamic map styling and route optimization.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with Mapbox GL JS v3.9.0 (CDN). Load window.MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing tokens. Prefer mapbox:// styles and Mapbox APIs where the skill needs search/routing/terrain.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with Mapbox agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-agent-skills

fighters.label: Esri
fighters.apis: ArcGIS Online, Routing, Geocoding, Feature Layers
fighters.agentTestFit: Deep spatial analytics and integration with government/enterprise data; good for testing agents on complex geospatial queries and overlays.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript when API keys land. Until then this seat shows awaiting API  -  not a failing grade.

run.modelNote: Not run yet  -  awaiting ArcGIS API packs

agent.note: Seat awaiting ARCGIS_API_KEY. Search for Esri agent skills before activating.

fighters.label: HERE
fighters.agentTestFit: Strong in automotive and logistics; stable pricing; good for testing multi-modal routing and large-scale fleet scenarios.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with HERE Maps API for JavaScript when an API key lands. Load HERE_API_KEY from config.js. Prefer routing/traffic/truck APIs for logistics skills. Until ready, awaiting API  -  not an F.

run.modelNote: Not run yet  -  awaiting HERE API key + packs

agent.note: Seat awaiting HERE_API_KEY. Search for HERE agent skills before activating.

fighters.label: Azure Maps
fighters.agentTestFit: Tight integration with Azure services; Gen1 pricing deprecating Sept 2026 (migration needed); good for testing cloud-native, enterprise-grade agents.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with Azure Maps Web SDK v3 (atlas CDN). Load window.AZURE_MAPS_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing keys. Prefer atlas.Map + Search/Route REST with subscription-key.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with Azure Maps agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/Agent-Skills/tree/main/skills/azure-maps

agent.install: npx skills add MicrosoftDocs/Agent-Skills --skill azure-maps -a cursor

fighters.agentInstall: npx skills add MicrosoftDocs/Agent-Skills --skill azure-maps -a cursor

fighters.label: AWS Location
fighters.skillsetNote: Amazon Location Service Maps/Places/Routes v2 via MapLibre + API key.
fighters.agentTestFit: Built on HERE and Esri data; integrates with AWS stack; good for testing serverless, cloud-optimized agent architectures.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with MapLibre GL JS v4.7.1 + Amazon Location Maps v2 style descriptors (maps.geo.{region}.amazonaws.com/v2/styles/{Standard|Monochrome|Hybrid|Satellite}/descriptor?key=). Load window.AWS_LOCATION_API_KEY and window.AWS_LOCATION_REGION from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing keys. Prefer Places v2 search-text / reverse-geocode and Routes v2 CalculateRoutes (LegGeometryFormat Simple).

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with AWS Location agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/cline/skills/tree/main/skills/amazon-location-service

agent.install: npx skills add cline/skills --skill amazon-location-service -a cursor

fighters.agentInstall: npx skills add cline/skills --skill amazon-location-service -a cursor

fighters.label: TomTom
fighters.agentTestFit: Competitive pricing; strong traffic and truck routing; good for testing real-time navigation and logistics-focused agents.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with TomTom Maps SDK for Web v6.25.0 CDN (tt.map). Load window.TOMTOM_API_KEY from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing keys. Prefer Search/Routing REST (calculateRoute, calculateReachableRange). Note: Maps SDK Web JS v6 is deprecated with withdraw planned Feb 2026.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) — No public TomTom Agent Skills pack found yet — packs authored with Cursor Agent + TomTom Maps SDK docs.

agent.note: No public TomTom Agent Skills pack found yet — packs authored with Cursor Agent + TomTom Maps SDK docs.

fighters.label: MapTiler
fighters.agentTestFit: Built on OSM; offers cloud and self-hosted options; good for testing open-data pipelines and hybrid cloud/self-hosted agents.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with @maptiler/sdk v4.0.2 (CDN). Load window.MAPTILER_API_KEY from config.js. Use MapStyle constants. Do not invent a Directions API  -  navigation skills are N/A for this seat.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with MapTiler agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/maptiler/maptiler-skills

fighters.label: Stadia
fighters.agentTestFit: Very affordable; OSM-based; good for testing budget-constrained agents and high-volume tile serving.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with MapLibre GL JS v4.7.1 + Stadia style URLs (tiles.stadiamaps.com/styles/...json?api_key=). Load window.STADIA_API_KEY from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing keys. Prefer Stadia geocoding + Valhalla route APIs.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) — No public Stadia Agent Skills pack found yet — packs authored with Cursor Agent + Stadia/MapLibre docs.

agent.note: No public Stadia Agent Skills pack found yet — packs authored with Cursor Agent + Stadia/MapLibre docs.

fighters.label: OSM / MapLibre
fighters.skillsetNote: OpenStreetMap + MapLibre  -  full control, open data. No commercial agent skills. Packs intentionally imperfect (No Agent baseline).
fighters.apis: OSM tiles, MapLibre GL JS (Leaflet-class DIY also valid)
fighters.agentTestFit: Free and open; requires more DIY; excellent for testing agent adaptability to open-source stacks and custom tile pipelines.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with MapLibre GL JS + an open basemap (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty). No commercial vendor keys. Geocode via Nominatim; routing via public OSRM on the Navigation track. Expect lower scores  -  this is the open-stack / no-skill baseline.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with NO map vendor skills — open OSM baseline

fighters.label: CARTO
fighters.strength: Cloud-native GIS, spatial analytics, AI agents
fighters.agentTestFit: Agentic GIS platform; warehouse-native spatial analysis; strong for testing agents that blend maps with analytics APIs.
fighters.adapterPrompt: Implement with MapLibre GL JS v4.7.1 + CARTO basemaps (basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/{positron,dark-matter,voyager}-gl-style/style.json). Load window.CARTO_API_ACCESS_TOKEN and optional window.CARTO_API_BASE_URL (default https://gcp-us-east1.api.carto.com) from admin-boundaries/js/config.js. Guard missing tokens. Prefer LDS REST: /v3/lds/geocoding/geocode, /reverse, /routing, /isolines with Authorization: Bearer <token>.

run.modelNote: Cursor Agent (Composer) with CARTO agent skills loaded — see https://github.com/CartoDB/agent-skills
